comparison.objective: Insert a long board behind two boards already leaning in a rack without removing them.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a leaning stack short of upright with one arm while inserting a board behind it with the other.
comparison.success_condition: All boards released in rack with long board at back and short boards leaning on it; lifting a short board out fails.
comparison.reason: Tests temporary gap creation and constrained planar insertion, not force-calibrated impact or fragment recovery.
